params.baseInstructions: Complete the supplied mathematical task using only its explicit inputs and tools. Submit the requested JSON artifact through submit_artifact. Tool feedback is real task feedback; do not invent a successful check. This is a Yui workflow stage. Read the relevant declared Yui rules, preserve the supplied proof route and exact allowed assumptions, and distinguish mathematical review from structural checks.

dynamicTools.name: read_task_input
dynamicTools.description: Read an explicitly frozen task document by ID; no other local files are accessible.

dynamicTools.name: read_yui
dynamicTools.description: Read declared Yui rules/templates; no tests, historical runs or personal files.

dynamicTools.name: check_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Check a JSON artifact against the explicit stage contract; this is not automatic mathematical certification.

dynamicTools.name: submit_artifact
dynamicTools.description: Submit a JSON artifact after its stage checks.

dynamicTools.name: report_obstacle
dynamicTools.description: Stop this stage honestly on a substantive or suspected proof gap, unavailable source, or input conflict. JSON fields: status, location, explanation, basis, partial_progress. Status must be SUBSTANTIVE_GAP, SUSPECTED_GAP, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE or INPUT_CONFLICT. Difficulty alone is not a mathematical error.

input.text:
Continue the exact supplied textbook proof along its existing route. Read all frozen task inputs and relevant Yui NL0 authoring/self-containment rules. The last author stopped early and supplied obstacle-report.json. Independently assess the actual claimed implication, rather than accepting that self-label as a substantive gap. Supply routine missing details when possible; do not weaken the target or change the core route. Your task in this stage is mathematical completion, not retranscribing a whole graph. Submit JSON {status, target, obstacle_assessment:{classification,reasoning}, complete_proof, source_obligations, edge_cases}. complete_proof must be self-contained, detailed, with each inferential step explicit; source_obligations distinguishes genuinely imported general facts from elementary derivations shown in full. Exact library candidates can be searched/read through allowed tools; verify actual applicability, never assume a theorem solely from a remembered name. Preserve all stated degeneracies and original assumptions. A difficulty or an unfinished standard lemma alone is not a mathematical gap. Do not treat previous proof claims or audit labels as established truth. If you identify a substantive defect, give the exact failed implication and mathematical grounds; otherwise complete the normal argument and submit. This is a disclosed warm development continuation, not a cold benchmark.

Yui entry: read_yui(path="SKILL.md", start=1, end=200). Available frozen rule paths (relative to rigorous-proof): SKILL.md, references/audit-a.md, references/external-theorems.md, references/isolation.md, references/lean-handoff.md, references/logical-rules.md, references/measurement.md, references/nl0-authoring.md, references/nl0-format.md, references/nl0-stage.md, references/self-containment.md, templates/audit-a.md, templates/authoring.md, templates/submission-example.md, translation/references/architecture.md, translation/references/audit-b.md, translation/references/design-notes.md, translation/references/experiments.md, translation/references/integrated-workflow.md, translation/references/obstacle-routing.md, translation/references/shared-lemmas.md, translation/references/source-refactoring.md, translation/references/stage.md, translation/references/translation-rules.md, translation/references/workflow.md, translation/templates/audit-b.md, translation/templates/source-refactoring.md. Every read supports at most 250 lines. Start with the entry and follow its relevant links; do not guess filenames.
Frozen task document IDs: obstacle-report.json, prior-candidate.json, problem.md, proof-draft.json, source-context.md. Use read_task_input to read them.
